sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Spec Kit is GitHub's open-source toolkit that gives AI coding agents structured processes. Its main process, Spec-Driven Development, turns a written specification into a plan, tasks and working code.
sixtySeconds.problem: Asking an agent to 'just build it' often leads to code that misses what you meant. Spec Kit has you write what to build and why first, then has the agent plan, break work into tasks and implement step by step, with reviewable documents along the way.
whoFor: Developers using GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or other coding agents
Teams that want agent work tied to written specs
Organisations that need to enforce standards through templates
People assessing whether an idea is worth building
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want a structured, documented way to work with coding agents that many agents support. For quick one-off edits, the process may be more than you need.

overview: Spec Kit offers ready-made processes: Spec-Driven Development for building features, a bug-fixing process that records cause, fix and verification, and an idea-assessment process that ends in a go, clarify or stop decision. These are separate entry points, not required phases.

Spec-Driven Development runs as skills in your agent's chat: create a constitution of project principles once, then for each feature run specify, plan, tasks, implement and converge, reviewing each result before the next.

It is customisable. Integrations connect different coding agents, extensions add commands and quality gates, presets change templates or enforce standards, workflows automate steps, and catalogs let teams share approved components. The README notes catalog listings are not audits, so review community code before installing.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.body: This example uses GitHub Copilot; other agents have their own integration key.
steps.code:
specify init my-project --integration copilot
cd my-project

steps.title: Launch your coding agent in the project directory

firstRun.title: Set project principles in your agent's chat
firstRun.code: /speckit-constitution Create principles focused on code quality, testing, and maintainability.

tutorial.title: Build a feature with Spec-Driven Development
tutorial.useCase: Go from an idea to working code with a spec, plan and tasks.
setup: Spec Kit installed and a project created with specify init
Your coding agent open in the project

steps.title: Create a constitution once
steps.code: /speckit-constitution Create principles focused on code quality, testing, and maintainability.

steps.title: Describe what to build
steps.code: /speckit-specify Build a photo organizer with albums grouped by date and a tile preview of each album.

steps.title: Choose the tech and plan
steps.code: /speckit-plan Use Vite with vanilla JavaScript. Keep images local and store metadata in SQLite.

steps.title: Break it into tasks, implement and converge
steps.body: Run these one at a time in the agent's chat, reviewing each result.

tutorial.expected: A spec, plan and task list in your project, and working code built from them.
